title: Let Me Sit!
description: A lightweight datapack that lets you sit wherever you want
body:
Let Me Sit!

Does what it says. Let's a player sit wherever they want (so long as they're "on the ground")

🕹 Installation

Let Me Sit! can be installed multiple ways. The simplest is through Modrinth, while Github can offer experimental versions.

Modrinth
  1. Download the correct version of the datapack
  2. Follow this guide to complete installation
Github

Releases

  1. Navigate to Github Releases
  2. Find the version of Death Swap you want
  3. In Assets, find and click the zip that has the version of Minecraft you're playing on
  4. Follow this guide to complete installation

Continuous Updates

  1. Install Git
  2. Open a terminal in your datapacks folder (follow step 4 in Releases if you need help)
  3. In the terminal, enter git clone https://github.com/Team-NPM/let-me-sit.git
  4. In the terminal, enter git checkout $(VERSION), replacing $(VERSION) with the datapack version you want (run git branch -l to see all branches)
  5. If the datapack ever updates, open a terminal in your datapacks folder and run git pull to update it quickly!

🎛 Running

Due to the sheer simplicity of the datapack, it'll run once installed and has no configuration. Once installed, any player can run /trigger Sit and will sit when they're "on the ground" and not moving.

🖫 Updating

To update this datapack, disable it by running /datapack disable let-me-sit_... (use tab completion to get the full name), remove it from the datapack folder, and follow the installation instructions with the new version.

🗑 Uninstalling

To uninstall the datapack, either run /function uninstall:sit or run /function sit:uninstall. Doing any of these options will remove all data from the world. Make sure to disable it afterwords.

🖇 Compatibility

There shouldn't be any incompatibility issues with this datapack. If there are, please report them below.

🖂 Reporting Issues

Have a problem? Report it! There are 2 ways to report issues.

Github Issues Head to https://github.com/Team-NPM/let-me-sit/issues and create an issue. You can also make suggestions there as well!
Discord Join the Discord and make a bug report in the correct channel. Once it's seen, a Github Issue will be created and linked.
